scope: Two user-rejected hammerhead tail/peduncle assemblies. Supersedes source-plane-only repair as a delivery criterion.
authority: User explicitly permits a smaller whole caudal fin to fit the peduncle. Scale is an art-direction choice, not a biological measurement.
section: Interpolate each model's actual terminal body polygon; retain every original basal vertex and root XY. Hidden thickness is a bounded construction inference.
source: Accepted species-specific side artwork and original nearest UV remain unchanged. Generated top/bottom tail silhouette is not an anatomy reference.
required_visual_scope: Whole fish proportion plus complete peduncle/caudal junction in side, opposite, top, bottom, rear and oblique clay/albedo/textured views; native animation, four actions and transitions.
